name: agent-screen
description: OS-level screenshot primitive for non-web Visual QA and installed-app dogfood. Captures a real desktop PNG explicitly on demand via ffmpeg x11grab plus X11 window helpers when available; fails closed when no display/backend is present. V1 is screenshot-only; bounded screen recording is deliberately deferred.

ffmpeg.manual: Install ffmpeg from https://ffmpeg.org/download.html. agent-screen v1 uses ffmpeg's x11grab input on Linux/WSLg.

xdotool.manual: Install xdotool plus X11 utilities (xdpyinfo and xwininfo). Debian/Ubuntu: `sudo apt install xdotool x11-utils`; Fedora: `sudo dnf install xdotool xorg-x11-utils`; Arch: `sudo pacman -S xdotool xorg-xdpyinfo xorg-xwininfo`.
